caseName: Clark v. Community for Creative Non-Violence
caseNameFull: Clark, Secretary of the Interior v. Community for Creative Non-Violence

opinions.text:
C. A. D. C. Cir. [Certiorari granted sub nom. Watt v. Community for Creative Non-Violence, ante, p. 812.] Motion of respondents for leave to file supplemental joint appendix not in compliance with this Court’s Rule 33 denied.

Justice Blackmun and Justice Stevens would grant this motion.
